Paragraph: "By your grace, oh, lion among men, let me regain my wife and kingdom too... oh, god of humans, as to how he does not suffer me again, thus you may please make happen... let not my elder brother turned as an enemy of mine suffer me again...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Expressing ultimate dependence and seeking permanent liberation from abuse.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva surrenders his worries to Rama, praying for permanent safety and restoration.
Outcome/Resolution: Final alignment of faith and protection.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Surrendering chronic worry to a trusted protector

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Prapatti (complete surrender and trust in the savior)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sugreeva surrenders his fears entirely through prapatti, placing his destiny in Rama's hands.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Releasing the burden of chronic trauma by trusting a capable and compassionate protector.
